SELECT bel.bibliography_id, bel.entity_type, bel.entity_id, bs.title
FROM bibliography_entity_links bel
JOIN bibliography_sources bs ON bs.id = bel.bibliography_id
WHERE bs.notes LIKE '%OpenAlex%'
LIMIT 10;

SELECT COUNT(*) as total_openalex FROM bibliography_sources WHERE notes LIKE '%OpenAlex%';
